opposite-tones-comparison.assessment: User reported neutral and switching recordings sounded the same, with no perceived difference.
opposite-tones-comparison.interpretation: The single global written direction did not demonstrate useful anger-reassurance-anger switching in this example. This does not establish that all instruction control fails.
opposite-tones-comparison.recommended_next_test: Independently generate each sentence with its own contrasting direction, audition before joining, and compare to the neutral control. If single-sentence contrast also fails, investigate a verified performance-transfer method rather than more global emotion prompting.

isolated-tones-neutral-vs-reassurance.assessment: User reported neutral and reassurance did not differ much.
isolated-tones-neutral-vs-reassurance.interpretation: Independent single-line written direction did not demonstrate a useful neutral/reassurance contrast for this listener; other isolated contrasts were not rated.
